why_best: Isolating core concepts into forceful, rhythmic visual impacts gives editorial statements maximum gravitas and guarantees zero viewer distraction.
why_bad: A gentle, continuous scroll or subtle fade would completely undermine the urgent, high-stakes nature of a critical broadcast update.
trap: A near-miss will allow the visual weight to drift or linger between arrivals, diluting the sharp, authoritative cadence required for high-impact coverage.
